product.description: Totul este pe cale să se schimbe... Cacirc;nd Thomas se trezește intr-un loc necunoscut, nu-și aminteștedecacirc;t cum il cheamă. Mintea ii este ca o foaie albă. Icirc;n jurul lui se aflămai mulți băieți, care ii urează bun-venit in Poiană ndash; un loc inconjuratde ziduri de piatră. La fel ca Thomas, Poienarii nu au nici o idee desprefelul in care au ajuns acolo și nici din ce motiv. Tot ceea ce știueste că, in fiecare dimineață, porțile de piatră către labirintul care iiinconjoară se deschid și că in fiecare seară se inchid la loc. Şi, la fiecaretreizeci de zile, un nou băiat apare acolo, adus cu un lift. Așadar,Thomas era așteptat. Cu totul neașteptat, a doua zi este trimisă acolo și o fată ndash; primafată din grup. Şi mai surprinzător decacirc;t sosirea ei este mesajul pe careil aduce. Thomas ar putea fi mai important decacirc;t ar fi crezut vreodată.Numai de-ar putea să scoată la iveală secretele intunecate ingropateinăuntrul minții sale.

# The Labyrinth: Evadarea (Vol. 1) by Litera

Dive into a gripping mystery that challenges everything you know about reality, memory, and survival. *The Labyrinth: Evadarea* plunges readers into a world where secrets are walled off by stone structures and the truth is buried deep within the subconscious mind. This compelling entry in the contemporary young adult genre promises an unforgettable journey of discovery as characters race to uncover what lies beyond their confined existence.

## ð A World Trapped Within Stone Walls

Thomas wakes up with amnesia in an unfamiliar place, unable even to recall his own name. His mind feels like a blank slateâa mystery waiting to be solved. He finds himself among many other boys housed in "The Meadow," a location enclosed by imposing stone walls that define their entire reality. Like Thomas, the inhabitants of The Meadow have no idea how they arrived or why.

Their routine is unsettlingly predictable: every morning, the stone gates surrounding their labyrinthine home open; and every night, they secure themselves once more. Adding to the mystery, a new boy arrives through an elevator exactly every thirty daysâmeaning Thomas was expected. But when the second day dawns, an unexpected element enters the group: a girl, the very first female arrival in The Meadow. She brings with her not just herself, but a critical message that suggests Thomas may be far more significant than he could ever imagine.

## ðï¸ Unearthing Forgotten Secrets

This thrilling narrative follows Thomas as he grapples with his fragmented memories and the perilous truth swirling around him. To survive and understand their predicament, he must confront secrets dark and deepâsecrets supposedly hidden within the very core of his own mind. *The Labyrinth: Evadarea* masterfully blends elements of dystopian fiction, psychological mystery, and coming-of-age drama, making it a highly addictive read for fans of speculative young adult literature.

**What to Expect:**
*   A complex atmosphere of suspense and uncertainty.
*   Intriguing character dynamics as the group navigates their mysterious confinement.
*   A powerful exploration of memory loss and identity.
